concept.title: Why the order of effects matters
concept.shortdesc: Clean first, then shape: noise reduction before compression, and normalization last.

conbody.p: Every effect works on whatever the previous one left. Compression raises quiet passages, so background noise compressed before it is removed becomes louder and harder to profile. Normalization sets the final peak, so anything applied after it can push the audio into clipping.
A safe order for spoken word: noise reduction, editing, compression, normalization, export.
